{{Quote|Keep your nose out of our business! Lady Valarian does not appreciate interference.|Kavas Urdano, to a medic|<ref name="SWG:CitC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Medic|Caught in the Crossfire|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Kavas Urdano''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] criminal who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I would guess that you're here to earn Lady Valarian's respect. This is a wise choice, my friend. Work for me first, and I will spread word of your courage and fidelity.|Kavas Urdano, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KU" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Kavas Urdano worked for [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian criminal syndicate]], in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Kavas was in charge of Valarian's [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations. The Chiss woman was one of the two main lieutenants of Lady Valarian, the other being the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] woman [[Ind]]. Urdano and Ind had a very conflicting relationship as both competed for getting Valarian's attention.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the conflict between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and Lady Valarian, her biggest competitor on Tatooine, turned to open war. At that time, Kavas Urdano recruited skilled [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to help her with several missions. These adventurers first proved their loyalty by assassinating the traitor [[Cie Vos]]. The spacers were then dispatched by Kavas to fight a group of Jabba's enforcers came to eliminate Valarian operatives on the edge of Mos Eisley. In another mission, they rescued Lady Valarian's [[Lawyer/Legends|advocate]] [[Ysho]] from Jabba's henchmen. The spacers later collected a [[Camera/Legends|camera]] from an individual named [[Ki'shai]] and brought it back to Urdano. They also assassinated one of Jabba's thugs who harassed the patrons of the ''Lucky Despot''. For their last mission, Kavas Urdano tasked the spacers with finding and killing one of Jabba's assassins who had failed in murdering Lady Valarian but had managed to grab most of the Valarian financial records. Again, the adventurers were successful and eventually returned with the sensitive information before it was delivered to Jabba. Lady Valarian was so pleased by this outcome that she requested the spacers to go work for Ind in the inner sanctum of the ''Lucky Despot''.<ref name="SWG:KU" />

Later the same year, many people were caught in a firefight between Lady Valarian's guards and [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's thugs]] in Mos Eisley. A [[Medic/Legends|medic]] sent by the [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B droid]] [[2-1b-58|Billingsly]] attempted to examine a wounded man named [[Jorund Redd]]. However, Kavas Urdano sent thieves to attack the medic as she did not appreciate people interfering with Lady Valarian"s business. Surprisingly, the medic managed to kill both thieves and then treated Redd's injuries.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kavas Urdano was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kavas Urdano was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:KU" />

With "[[W:c:swg:Publish 20 Notes for 19 July 2005|Publish 20]]" released on [[July 19]], [[2005]], it was announced that the "Valarian Quest Series" would be phased out during "[[W:c:swg:Publish 22 Notes for 16 August 2005|Publish 22]]" to make way for a revamped questline during "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]."<ref name="SonyCite-Valarian Quest Update">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Current%20Publish|text=Valarian Quest Update}}</ref> The story of this new [https://swglegends.com/forums/showthread.php?55817-*Friday-Feature-Valarian-Themepark-Walkthrough!*Valarian Themepark] was centered on the rivalry between Ind and Kavas Urdano.<ref name="Sony" /> While the old Valarian Quest Series was fully deactivated by Publish 23 on [[August 31]], [[2005]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref> the newly proposed questline was never fully implemented to replace it. Kavas Urdano remained present in the game but was not involved in any quest anymore.<ref name="SWG:P25">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Publish 25}}</ref>
